acceptance.scope: Production payload and shared installer logic; lowest privilege, private paths/registry, no shortcuts or launch, unique AppId. Not machine-wide production installer acceptance.

verified: Real production payload copied by compiled Inno installer.
Existing registered custom history is retained across installation and repair.
All twelve redirected native-host registrations point to the installed manifests, then are removed during uninstall.
Missing recovery script is restored byte-for-byte by reinstall/repair.
Configuration, history and partial bytes preserved.
fixtureAlterations: Unique AppId, lowest privileges, private installation/history/registry/lock.
Compression disabled for the test installer.
initialFailure: Fixture incorrectly made fallback and custom history identical, so no redirect file was needed. Corrected to separate locations.
limitations: Not a production machine-wide admin upgrade/repair/uninstall test.
No running personal app, extension or elevated helper was replaced.
Clean Windows, failure injection across every setup phase and full IDM parity remain unqualified.
